newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Santam hopeful premium rises may stabilise.
newsitem.headline: Santam hopeful premium rises may stabilise.

text.p: South African insurer Santam Ltd said on Monday that it was hopeful the rise in premium rates, boosted by the country's crime wave, would stabilise.

"We are hopeful that efforts by the authorities on the one hand and by the business sector on the other to combat crime will have a stabilising effect on premium increases," the firm said in a statement with its year results.

The firm said it was encouraged that the number of vehicles stolen in the pst year increased only slightly compared to 1995. But it said the amount paid out increased by 12.6 percent as the average cost per vehicle claim went up.
Earlier the group posted a rise in earnings per share to 242 cents from 211 cents.
